name: Cathedral
notes: Designated April 1972 (council layer: 'City of Manchester (CATHEDRAL) Conservation Area 1972'; Historic England UID 512, 1 April 1972). Reference is the HE UID, as for the other MAN entities; 512 is not used on the PDP. Geometry from the council layer (OBJECTID 7, 8.1 ha; HE UID 512 has the same boundary). The council site returns HTTP 403 to scripts, so the page and map URLs were not verified with curl; the new site also has the page https://www.manchester.gov.uk/parks-leisure-and-the-arts/parks-playgrounds-allotments-and-open-spaces/conservation-areas/Cathedral-conservation-area-maps. Not the same as Salford's 'Cathedral conservation area' (PDP 44012728), which covers only 15% of it. Boundary from Manchester City Council ArcGIS Online layer 'Conservation Areas' (LDF service, layer 31), feature 'City of Manchester (CATHEDRAL) Conservation Area 1972': https://services3.arcgis.com/HFpQvhZ7zqF7O2S8/arcgis/rest/services/LDF/FeatureServer/31
